source.subtitle: Apps by horsehound
source.description: Personal apps by horsehound, built from their GitHub repos.

apps.name: SwipeClean
apps.subtitle: Swipe through your photos month by month.
apps.localizedDescription: Go through your photo library one month at a time. Swipe left to mark a photo for deletion, right to keep it. Favourite and share photos on the way. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SwipeClean shows your photos so you can swipe to keep or delete them.

apps.name: Fetch
apps.subtitle: Move text and pictures between your devices.
apps.localizedDescription: One live feed shared by your iPhone, laptop and PC, served by a small hub you host yourself. Paste or share text, pictures and files on one device and pick them up on the others. Unpinned items delete themselves after a week. Needs a Fetch hub: github.com/horsehound/fetch

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Fetch talks to your hub on your home network.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Fetch saves pictures from your other devices to your photo library.
